item_0.question: Which file formats can you work with?
item_0.answer: File requirements depend on the work. Share your available source files and intended outputs so the studio can confirm the right production path before work begins.

item_1.question: How is turnaround planned?
item_1.answer: Timing is scoped around image count, complexity, source quality, feedback stages, and final delivery needs. A schedule is confirmed for each project rather than assumed in advance.

item_2.question: How do revisions work?
item_2.answer: Revision needs are agreed during scoping. Clear visual references and consolidated feedback help the studio keep decisions consistent across the full image set.

item_3.question: How should files be transferred?
item_3.answer: The transfer method is confirmed with the project. Production files should be shared through an agreed secure workspace rather than public links containing sensitive material.

item_4.question: Can you keep a large batch visually consistent?
item_4.answer: Yes. Reference frames, shared finishing rules, and review checkpoints can be established before a larger batch moves through production.

item_5.question: Can the studio join an existing creative workflow?
item_5.answer: The studio can work from your naming, review, and delivery conventions when those requirements are shared during scoping.

hero.subtitle: Studio Click House shapes still and moving images for brands, studios, and production teams that care about the final frame.

intro.subtitle: Studio Click House is a Bangladesh-based image post-production studio serving photographers, creative agencies, online shops, and retailers worldwide. Since 2022, we have delivered image editing and retouching for consistent, production-ready visual content.
intro.copy: Our team of 150+ designers brings 4–16 years of individual experience and works 24/7 to support demanding image volumes and deadlines.

aboutDescription.tagline: The human craft and technical discipline behind world-class visuals.
aboutDescription.paragraph1: Studio Click House is an international visual post-production house serving world-class photographers, global fashion brands, e-commerce retailers, and creative agencies.
aboutDescription.paragraph2: We specialize in editorial image retouching, video color grading, and photorealistic 3D CGI product rendering. Combining meticulous human artistry with an overnight 24/7 production pipeline, our studio ensures every frame meets uncompromising creative and commercial standards.
aboutDescription.quote: Every pixel, shadow, and color gradient is shaped to reflect your brand's unique visual signature.

aiAbout.subtitle: Experience our precision color-grading and AI-assisted finishing workflow. Interactive colorway adjustments maintain accurate fabric texture, realistic light diffusion, and immaculate detail across your entire product line.
aiAbout.copy: Seamlessly switch between custom colorways below to inspect the micro-texture integrity and calibrated color fidelity.

scrollImage.copy1: Accelerate your motion pipeline with generative AI. From model-generated shots with Kling, Flow, and Veo to AI motion upscaling and cinematic finishing, we deliver broadcast-ready video tuned for global campaigns.
scrollImage.copy2: AI video post-production accelerates the workflow — streamlining generative shot creation, complex cutdowns, color balance, and visual cleanup with artisan oversight at every frame.
scrollImage.copy3: Generated or captured, every sequence is finished by senior colorists and editors. We blend Kling, Google Flow, Runway, and Luma-generated footage with expert grading and frame-by-frame review for pristine fidelity, temporal consistency, and cinematic storytelling.

processSteps.title: Brief and file intake

processSteps.title: Reference alignment
